name: Fake app-scoped object storage contract matrix
target: App-scoped upload, quota, media-type, signed URL, anonymous rate-limit, and provider-error decisions against the real local ObjectStore boundary
inputs: app slug and relative object key
app quota and anonymous upload rate
signed PUT URL, expiry, and method
observations: all stored keys stay under apps/<slug>/
path escape and invalid media type rejection
quota rejection leaves prior bytes unchanged
valid signed upload and expiry, signature, or method rejection
byte-and-status-only ledger with no request body
